author: Abhishek Leji
name: SpinQuant V1 + PR #1851 Base + LQER Asym + Phased TTT (EMBED_BITS ablation)
notes_on_track: Non-record ablation. Two sub-runs: (A) EMBED_BITS=8 — best quality but 16,956,923 bytes oversize; (B) EMBED_BITS=6 — legal size 15,921,823 bytes but embedding quantization degrades final BPB. Full 3-seed record submission in track_10min_16mb.
technique_summary: SpinQuant V1 (per-layer Hadamard pre-rotation of all Q/K/V/Out/Up/Down before GPTQ, zero serialized bytes) grafted onto PR #1851 base (CaseOps + SparseAttnGate + SmearGate-BOS-fix + LQER-Asym rank-4 + 3-phase Phased TTT). EMBED_BITS=8 demonstrates SpinQuant reduces GPTQ damage from +0.00916 (PR #1851 base) to +0.00640 (-30%). EMBED_BITS=6 demonstrates the legal-size tradeoff: SpinQuant's ~1MB brotli entropy penalty forces EMBED_BITS=6, which adds +0.01093 embedding quantization damage, making the net worse than baseline. Full record submission uses EMBED_BITS=6 and targets 3-seed mean.
